effect.name: Threshold
effect.description: Two colours, one cut-off. Everything brighter than the threshold becomes the light colour, everything darker becomes the dark one. A 1-bit look for title cards, silhouette puzzles and stark flash frames.
effect.author: CyberMushroom

parameter.name: Dark Colour
parameter.description: Colour for pixels below the cut-off.

parameter.name: Light Colour
parameter.description: Colour for pixels above the cut-off.

parameter.name: Cutoff
parameter.description: The brightness that splits dark from light.

parameter.name: Softness
parameter.description: Width of the fade across the cut-off. 0 is a hard edge and will alias on a diagonal.

parameter.name: Amount
parameter.description: Blends the result back over the original.
